facets.description: Plural *_ids branch in store.js.es6 _hydrateEmbedded puts undefined entries in the array when sideloaded records are missing; there is no guard like the singular branch's if (hydrated)
Plural branch calls obj[k].map with no null check, so a null *_ids value throws a TypeError
Plural branch always deletes the *_ids key and replaces it with the pluralized key, even when hydration fails, which changes the shape of existing models
